question: What lower-case scalar bibliographic fields already present in the exact Zhao Wanli NCPSsd detail object close the page range, publication date, abstract and keyword locator without following any URL?
answer: Replaying only the same already-closed detail POST returns the identical 2426-byte object and closes beginpage=221, endpage=233, publishdate=1951-09-01, source=nssd, a Chinese abstract, keywordc, firstwriter=趙萬里, vol=0 and volumn=1951. No new endpoint is executed and no URL-like value is followed. Together with KY, the NCPSsd detail now reproduces the same year/issue/page-range bundle as the separate NLC Wenjin and NLC scholarly-review records.
